articles.title: Vanguard opens search for digital assets leader in sign of evolving crypto strategy
articles.snippet: The new role would oversee tokenization, stablecoins and blockchain initiatives as Vanguard reassesses digital assets.

articles.title: Former Tether investment chief is looking to sell part of his stake in the stablecoin giant: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: Richard Heathcote is reportedly working with PJT Partners to find a buyer for a small part of his 1.26% holding in the issuer of USDT following his transition to an advisory role.

articles.title: Circle’s USDC is leaving Tether behind in the stablecoin volume race, new data from Visa shows
articles.snippet: As Wall Street banks adopt digital currencies for faster settlements, overall trading volume spiked 63% in just a single month.

articles.title: USDT wins payments, USDC wins DeFi as stablecoins diverge: Dune
articles.snippet: Dune data shows Tether's USDT has become crypto’s dominant payments stablecoin while Circle's USDC powers DeFi, highlighting how blockchain choice shapes stablecoin use.

articles.title: MiCA-compliant euro stablecoins grew 128% ahead of July 1 deadline, says Decta
articles.snippet: Decta's report said the market cap of eight MiCA-compliant euro stablecoins rose to $673.9 million in the year before Europe’s CASP transition period ended.
